lines.text: Astra now gets a film's own address from TorBox: a safety check was wrongly refusing TorBox's real answers.
Your server no longer opens add-on links itself; that made some streams play an error clip instead of the film.
A tap asks TorBox three times, not four, and once for a film played in the last half hour.
In AIOStreams, add {stream.infoHash} to your formatter's description so every stream can go to TorBox directly.
